name: LWSABAH
recent: Life Water Berhad 近期完成以 RM46.8 million 收购三家公司 90% 股权的交易，并以 RM15 million 收购 KKIP 工业区土地及办公楼。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收同比增长 28.0%，净利同比增长 21.0%。此外，公司将于 2026 年 12 月 18 日召开第三届常年股东大会。
notable: 完成以 RM46.8 million 收购 Hung On Thong Mini Supermarket Sdn. Bhd.、Hung Tai Enterprise (Sabah) Sdn. Bhd. 及 Kilang Mee Ban Soon Sdn. Bhd. 各 90% 股权。
以 RM15 million 现金收购位于 KKIP 的一幅土地及附设办公楼和附属车间。
risks: 非独立非执行高级董事 Mr. Tan Hwong Kuen 于 2026 年 9 月 7 日出售 93,100 股普通股。
独立非执行董事 Madam Selma Enolil Binti Mustapha Khalil 于 2026 年 9 月 8 日出售 40,000 股普通股。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM57.0 million，环比增长 17.5%，同比增长 28.0%；净利为 RM10.95 million，环比增长 36.1%，同比增长 21.0%；净利率为 19.2%，高于上一季度的 16.6%。

recent_en: Life Water Berhad recently completed the acquisition of a 90% equity interest in three companies for RM46.8 million and acquired land with an office complex in KKIP for RM15 million. Revenue for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 grew 28.0% year-on-year, with net profit up 21.0%.
notable_en: Completed the acquisition of a 90% equity interest in Hung On Thong Mini Supermarket Sdn. Bhd., Hung Tai Enterprise (Sabah) Sdn. Bhd. and Kilang Mee Ban Soon Sdn. Bhd. for RM46.8 million.
Acquired a parcel of land with a purpose-built office complex and ancillary workshop in KKIP for RM15 million cash.
risks_en: Non-Independent Non-Executive Senior Director Mr. Tan Hwong Kuen disposed of 93,100 ordinary shares on 7 September 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Director Madam Selma Enolil Binti Mustapha Khalil disposed of 40,000 ordinary shares on 8 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM57.0 million, up 17.5% QoQ and 28.0% YoY; net profit was RM10.95 million, up 36.1% QoQ and 21.0% YoY; net margin was 19.2%, up from 16.6% in the previous quarter.
